wizards.name: Aldric the Unwritten
wizards.blurb: Robe of deep violet, an orbiting focus he never actually touches. Reads three spells ahead of you.

wizards.name: Brann Cinderhand
wizards.blurb: Wide-brim traveller's hat, scorched hem, a staff that has been on fire more than once.

wizards.name: Sister Vela
wizards.blurb: Hooded, ring-collared, carrying a socket of live rime shards. Speaks only when the room is quiet.

wizards.name: Old Morrow
wizards.blurb: Granite pauldrons, moss-green wool, a rune-stone club. Argues with rocks and usually wins.

wizards.name: Kessa Voltmark
wizards.blurb: Tall narrow hat, hair that has not lain flat in years, a copper-coiled conducting rod.

wizards.name: The Hollow Warden
wizards.blurb: Deep hood with nothing under it but two lights. Tattered hem, horned skull standard.
